policy.exposure: The eight confirmation conversations were excluded from this policy selection, but prior project experiments have used all ten conversations. This is confirmation after prior project exposure, not globally unseen data.
policy.failureHandling: Source/control incompatibility aborts admission. Candidate selection exceptions remain as empty contexts (zero for eligible recall/MRR) with explicit errors; no exclusions.
policy.goldBoundary: Retain only the frozen two context arms, and finish all context selection before invoking evidenceMetrics or historical score-integrity checks.
policy.qualification: Offline retrieval/context-allocation experiment from previously captured semantic top20; no reader, judge, model, native backend, provider or answer-accuracy claim.
policy.selection: Selected only on conv-49/conv-50, highest development turn recall with the already frozen simplicity tie rule; no retuning.
